scope: C2-03 route module security review inventory

classificationLegend.PUBLIC_OR_TOKEN_GATED_REVIEW: Expected public, signed, token-gated, or webhook flows; manual verification required.
classificationLegend.AUTHENTICATION: Authentication/session routes; verify anonymous vs authenticated handler expectations.
classificationLegend.AUTHENTICATED_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Assumed protected route module; verify route-level authorization and tenant scope.
